description: 新北市颱風期間各型移動式抽水機佈設資訊 [stormwater and drainage and typhoons, cyclones and storms] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 新北市政府水利局. 提供本市陸上颱風警報發佈後於易積淹水地區佈設各型移動式抽水機之基本資訊(如：地區、位置、機型名稱、數量、排出口). Coverage: New Taipei City. The portal files it under the publisher 新北市政府水利局. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-08-11 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
